path_policy: Existing catalogs, attempts, corrections and updater/writer ownership remain canonical. New turn/diagnostic/review state is operational under the existing run area; exports are derived. Concrete child paths remain proposals. No parallel graph/gap authority.

workflows.name: Observe, admit and dispatch
reads: Local runtime ledger and existing publication receipts
Pinned native surface/version and effective target permissions; never assume danger-full-access config is a safe thread
Actual existing updater completion/publication receipts, not only a scheduler success message
steps: Validate requester, course, workflow, parent turn, permissions, bounds and committed hashes; reject path/command injection.
Assign or reuse a stable request/job identity. Preserve client occurrence time separately from host receipt time.
Create the local journal entry transactionally, then export a receipt; duplicates reuse the original receipt. Same ID with different content conflicts.
Claim a ready job using one local lease, expected input revisions, a fencing generation and the course/thread concurrency key.

Dispatch only through the version-scoped, approved native route after its resident-process return path is proven. Installed queue help is a candidate; Windows 10050 is a failed default control connection, not a proven queue/root-cause diagnosis. Stage results and use the proper writer.
Schedule the next eligible item. When nothing is runnable, release model workers and wait for external events/timers.
staged: Local runtime database/journal, leases and provider run IDs
published: Inbox acknowledgement or rejection receipt
exports/learning-app/jobs/<job-id>/state.json
exports/learning-app/workflows/<workflow-id>/task.md (derived backlog view)
success: Each eligible committed request has one admitted identity or an explicit rejection; accepted outputs have traceable receipts.
Idle queues cause no reasoning-model polling calls; blocked jobs do not prevent unrelated ready jobs.
blocked: Unknown native entry point or missing capabilities
Safe effective native permissions or process-readable terminal result unavailable
Runtime version changes while a turn outcome is unknown
never: Modify original materials, grades, learner judgments or provider credentials
Let task text select arbitrary tools, shell commands, roots, models or spending
Treat approved:true in Drive, native login category or queue exit as authority/completion
Start an alternative server, use a different worker or broaden sandbox permissions silently
workflows.change_rationale: Monitoring and queue control are ordinary software; native reasoning must be called only through a tested target/return boundary.
workflows.current_vs_new_boundary: Existing scheduled jobs are real, but immediate submitted-task admission, independent native-thread roundtrip and app correlation are not operationally established.

workflows.name: Consume existing source discovery and publication
triggers: Explicit rescan of a known source
reads: Canonical source index and publication contracts
steps: Read current existing updater source-audit/final-verification receipts and source publications; retain all-lecture coverage, including presently unindexed originals.
Classify newly observed, changed, missing, empty, moved, unrecorded and still-hydrating material. A folder/date or unchanged stat does not establish source association/currentness.
Reuse or request a bounded scan through the current updater owner under approved policy. Do not add a competing scheduled scanner that independently interprets/publishes the same sources.
Prepare any registration candidate for the existing source/tracking publisher. A future small changed-source receipt extension belongs to that updater; it is not installed by this design.
Admit downstream WF02/WF03 once the relevant publication and actually checked source evidence agree. Distinguish no-op, staged, partial and changed publication; deduplicate by source/version/receipt.

Keep current per-run safety caps. To drain a larger initial backlog, obtain an approved continuation/receipt extension in the existing updater; the downstream supervisor does not bypass its publication or schedule policy.
staged: Source inventory/registration candidate and exact consumed-source references
published: Existing source index/publication bundle only through the current updater/publisher
exports/learning-app/material-coverage.json (derived proposal)
Operational receipt of consumed updater revision and unresolved availability
success: Every source in the bounded batch is accounted for and identities are preserved; registration receipt or explicit block recorded.
All-lecture denominator remains visible across batches. Missing original media are not called processed or synthesized as original.
never: Change grades, deadlines or personal progress as a side effect
Make a duplicate scheduled source-refresh publisher
Treat generated study assets as instructor originals
Infer physical-source freshness from the known ineffective verify-published --check-source-files branch
Treat every receipt poll as a reason for a new model turn
workflows.change_rationale: A second source scheduler/publisher creates conflicting identity/review decisions. A bounded batch is fine; forgetting the remaining backlog is not.
workflows.current_vs_new_boundary: The installed source refresh and protected publication have historical receipts; current processing is bounded (reported at most three sources per course/run).

workflows.name: Prepare renditions and align evidence
triggers: Registered source version needs a rendition or alignment
reads: Exact deck, media and raw transcript revisions
steps: Preserve originals. Produce version-keyed text/page/rendition assets only with required conventional tools; use OCR only where native text/visual reading cannot suffice.
Determine whether the transcript is verbatim, edited or partial and whether video actually displays slides. Establish media identity, duration and time origin.
Reuse valid timestamps; otherwise perform approved local transcription/forced alignment. Original and corrected transcript versions remain distinct.
Associate spans with displayed slides and/or discussed concepts using available evidence. Permit repeats, overlaps, multiple intervals, clips and no reliable match.
Validate IDs, intervals, page bounds, edition/page mappings and immutable source revisions; preserve manual corrections and record review state.

Preserve reviewed source-map corrections through their owner, record exact evidence and publish a versioned derived alignment view. A missing current structured link store needs an explicit owner-compatible schema extension, not a silent parallel learning graph. Invalidate only dependencies affected.

Distinguish a cache from a newly reviewed source annotation. Before the first new precise interval is accepted, bind its durable versioned record to the existing source-link owner; exports remain projections, not the sole copy of a manual correction.
published: .cache/learning-app/<source-version>/... (rebuildable local intermediates)
exports/learning-app/renditions/<source-version>/... (permitted cross-device assets)
Per-slide alignment coverage projection
.agent/course-learning/runs/<run>/proposals/alignment.json and reviewed link evidence receipts (new child proposal)
exports/learning/alignment.json (derived, source-version-specific proposal; underlying reviewed maps/source refs stay authoritative)
success: Artifacts match their input/tool revisions; every slide and relevant interval has a mapping/review/availability disposition.
Machine-proposed links are labeled as such. Confirmed matching quality requires independent reviewed examples; artifact publication alone is not alignment proof.
blocked: Untested discovered transcription package or unapproved processing/data scope
never: Invent a time interval or textbook page
Overwrite raw transcripts or original decks
Treat omitted material as a fully verified match
workflows.change_rationale: Reuse existing reviewed work but do not call transcript line numbers recording seconds. Preserve new manual timing assertions durably.
workflows.current_vs_new_boundary: Reviewed slide-to-transcript-line maps and selected render assets exist; complete timing, typed anchors and browser media delivery do not.

workflows.name: Extend owned catalogs and project concept trees
triggers: New usable content or approved graph/source-link correction
A tutoring task encounters a genuinely unmapped concept
reads: BE 505 learning/question-index.json where installed; reviewed shared mappings
Source/version anchors and existing reviewed source maps
Previous accepted catalog revisions and projection manifests
steps: Resolve existing concept, skill, criterion, question and family IDs before proposing anything new. Identical labels across courses do not establish equivalence.

Extract source-supported additions or changes as proposals for the owning catalog. Missing concepts in another course are a coverage gap; do not mislabel a topic as a skill or install a second canonical catalog.
Validate only the owning contract's relationship types, direction and graph constraints. Do not reinterpret question strict_containment as an arbitrary concept taxonomy.

Build hierarchical/tree projections referencing the same IDs in multiple branches; guard traversal against cycles and mark nonhierarchical/uncertain relationships. No automatic prerequisite failure or learning credit.
Publish permitted catalog changes via its coordinated owner, under genuine approved scope. Preserve old rubric/family revisions and review merges, retirement and shared equivalence separately.
Render concept-tree views with exact input/tool/schema revisions and freshness. Rebuild views, not definitions, for layout changes. Stop at the requested coverage boundary.
published: Existing canonical skills/families/question catalogs only through their approved owner
exports/learning/concept-tree.json and optional lecture/slide Markdown views (derived child proposals)
success: No duplicate logical identities, forbidden cycles or broken references; nodes/edges retain provenance and structural review status.
Each available source slice in scope is covered or explicitly unresolved. Published graph structure does not prove semantic correctness or learner competence.
never: Create a second authoritative definition for an existing concept
Automatically merge cross-course skills
Expand indefinitely into every prerequisite of every prerequisite
Create learning/concepts/revisions as another authoritative definition store
Invent missing hierarchy or publish a generated tree as verified subject truth
workflows.change_rationale: New material should extend the owned catalog, not spawn a duplicate graph authority or prerequisite forest.
workflows.current_vs_new_boundary: Agents curate skills/families and the richer BE 505 question structure; no automatic all-lecture semantic extractor/tree publisher is established.

workflows.name: Answer a source-grounded question
triggers: Explicit follow-up asking for explanation or a connection
reads: Full submitted question and referenced visual/source snapshot
Relevant concept neighborhood and source spans
Compact prior thread state with original references
steps: WF00 captures the full committed user-visible question and permitted attachments before inference in an immutable operational turn snapshot.

Resolve the intended course/source versions and valid owned-catalog projection; use verified source context directly if the concept view is incomplete. Record what instructions/evidence actually entered the native turn.
Retrieve minimal permissible context. Conflicts and missing evidence are stated, not silently filled from another course or inaccessible chat.
Generate a concise source-grounded answer using the selected native worker and approved capabilities.
Validate output references, content bounds, course/turn identity and render safety; publish the visible answer and delivery manifest.
Update thread continuity/resume projection. A request for help does not automatically become an assessment or weakness.
staged: Answer draft, source-reference list, context manifest
published: .agent/course-learning/runs/<run>/messages/<message-id>.json (full delivered tutor reply, separate from the frozen learner input)
exports/learning-app/results/<request>/<generation>/... (derived/transport reply bundle)
Operational session summary referencing original messages, generated by WF10
success: Correct request/thread receives a complete source-linked answer or an explicit uncertainty result; full submitted/delivered text is preserved.
No learner attempt or gap is fabricated merely from asking.
never: Claim unseen course history was loaded
Leak answer keys outside the mode policy
Award understanding because the assistant answered
workflows.change_rationale: The teaching behavior exists. The app needs exact context, request identity and visible history without treating help as failure.
workflows.current_vs_new_boundary: There are real native explanations and reusable lookup helpers; their externally triggered app path, complete record capture and process-readable return remain missing.

workflows.name: Assess a submitted explanation or answer
triggers: Learner replies to a diagnostic or review prompt
reads: Exact presented prompt and full learner response/attachments
Relevant canonical catalog revisions and projected subtree inputs
Relevant previous assessed responses only after initial independent assessment framing
steps: Persist and read back the exact prompt, learner response, attachments, occurrence time/basis and reference/assistance conditions before inference. Unknown timing/recognition stays qualified.

Select the actual family/rubric revision, or prepare a provisional source-grounded rubric for review before judging the answer. Accept justified alternative answers; generated references are not instructor keys.

Assess exactly the intended skills using existing outcomes and required analysis fields. No error diagnosis on not_observed. An unasked concept, graph hole or transcription ambiguity is not a learner failure.

Validate the immutable sidecar bytes and content/item identity with the proposed wrapper, then stage the unchanged course-learning-v1 candidate. The existing locator string alone does not validate its target.

Use the correct course writer under its real guard. Do not pass --root to the installed global-root BE 505 save/refresh as a fixture strategy. A future other-course facade must be tested before claiming common save semantics.

Read back a canonical attempt or a verified already_saved result. Keep staged hypotheses as diagnostic proposals; only published effective observations support gap views. If the evidence saved but its view failed, report both facts without duplicating the attempt.
Capture the complete delivered tutor message separately from frozen input; return sourced feedback and the distinct save/view receipt. Schedule WF06/WF10 or selected review work once.

A captured response without an available valid intended family remains ASSESSMENT_PENDING in operational state. Register/review a supported family and reassess against pinned intent before creating a canonical record; never invent unobserved errors or a successful record to empty the queue.
staged: Immutable full-input snapshot and wrapper verification receipt
Compatible attempt candidate and diagnostic proposal
Tutor feedback and canonical publication intent
published: .agent/course-learning/runs/<run>/turns/<turn-id>.json and referenced attachments (new child proposal)
Existing learning/attempts/YYYY-MM/<attempt-id>.json through the appropriate owner
.agent/course-learning/runs/<run>/messages/<message-id>.json and receipts/<receipt>.json
exports/learning/learning-gaps.json and learning-gaps.md only as WF10-derived views
success: One submitted learner response is retained once and every meaningful assessed criterion has an observed or explicitly uncertain/not-observed outcome.
Attempt publication is idempotent and read back; gaps cite the exact response and assessment. Feedback is correlated and the independent/assisted conditions are not rewritten.
never: Require agreement with one generated wording
Store an AI-written answer as the learner response
Count a retry or second grader as a second learner attempt
Claim unasked prerequisite failure
Modify a hashed learner snapshot to add a later assistant answer
Treat existence of a locator string as checked full-response persistence
Write a separate canonical gap-event history or report analysis as independent learner evidence
workflows.change_rationale: The correct improvement is a reliable interface to existing history, not a replacement gradebook or every-answer-is-new-performance rule.
workflows.current_vs_new_boundary: Actual attempts preserve outcome/assistance; BE 505 has a helper and other courses coordinated procedures. No general sidecar-integrity verifier or uniform safe save service exists.

workflows.name: Diagnose and remediate a specific difficulty
triggers: A submitted diagnostic answer links to an open hypothesis
reads: Course policy, shown hints and prior exposure
steps: List plausible explanations such as conceptual confusion, missing prerequisite, method slip, notation, ambiguous prompt, recognition error or grader mistake; avoid prematurely selecting one.
Choose one discriminating question or worked contrast grounded in sources. Default to a short detour; deeper diagnosis is opt-in.
Save and display the question/hint with its tested criteria and exposure event. Release the worker and mark WAITING_USER; do not invent a reply or poll an LLM for one.
A real learner reply creates a new WF05 job tied to the parent session and diagnostic prompt, not a rerun of the original answer.
Use the new evidence to support, contradict, narrow or leave hypotheses open. Offer targeted explanation plus an optional different transfer example.
Stop when the requested detour is complete, the learner declines, or review is needed. Root-cause uncertainty remains explicit.

On later correction, derive the current gap interpretation from the effective canonical assessment chain; an unresolved suspicion remains labeled separately and never becomes a second competence record.
staged: Diagnostic hypothesis set and minimal distinguishing question
Remediation plan constrained to requested depth
published: Immutable operational diagnostic turns and tutor messages
Observed assistance/exposure captured in the corresponding learner event
Unresolved diagnostic proposals under the existing run area; any assessment change through canonical assessment_revision
Optional review suggestions with provenance, not automatic calendar tasks
success: An appropriate diagnostic/remediation step is delivered and recorded, or new evidence updates the hypothesis without fabricated competence.
Question delivery can complete a turn while the wider diagnostic activity waits for the learner.
never: Run until the model decides the learner has mastered everything
Mark all ancestors weak
Erase earlier evidence after a hinted success
workflows.change_rationale: Mistakes have alternative explanations. Persistent proposals help continuity without falsely creating canonical root-cause diagnoses.
workflows.current_vs_new_boundary: Optional follow-up, help labeling and tutor-error acknowledgment exist in behavior/notes; no formal bounded multi-hypothesis workflow or waiting lifecycle is installed.

workflows.name: Prepare questions and richer review cards
triggers: Approved bounded preparation goal finds uncovered criteria
Specific selected gap suggests a useful review item
reads: Source-grounded learning targets and permitted solutions
steps: Reuse existing questions before generating near-duplicates. Select a bounded objective such as one diagram interpretation or concept contrast.
Prepare a versioned prompt, rubric, source references, expected alternatives and help policy; keep solution context separate from question-only delivery.
Check solvability, correct references, duplicate family/criterion coverage and difficulty claims; leave unsupported items as suggestions.
Offer selection/edit/suspend controls. Only items selected by the learner or an explicit reviewed auto-selection policy enter the active schedule.
Publish through catalog/review owners. Stop after the requested item/coverage budget, not an infinite complete-concept question expansion.
published: Existing question/family/rubric catalogs through their owner
Review-selection/card specifications under an approved operational run child (proposal, not a competence catalog)
exports/learning/review-items.json (derived selectable view)
success: Each requested item is source-linked, answerable/reviewed to the recorded level, versioned and nonduplicate, or explicitly rejected/pending.
No creation event is treated as a learner attempt.
never: Create a card for every noun
Automatically publish uncertain generated answers as authoritative
Rewrite previous card versions used by attempts
workflows.change_rationale: The goal is useful coverage, not many generated cards. A new prompt may reuse a family without duplicating its definition.
workflows.current_vs_new_boundary: Question/family authoring and a substantial BE 505 bank exist; a uniform versioned selectable rich-card workflow does not.

workflows.name: Schedule and conduct deliberate review
triggers: A selected review item becomes due
New eligible assessed review response arrives
steps: Use a maintained scheduling implementation after evaluation; the algorithm chooses timing, not the scientific reason for an error.
Build a bounded due queue and show the source-linked question. No background agent answers on the learner behalf.
Route a real response to WF05 and optional WF06; preserve source access and hints.
Map only supported evidence/user grading into scheduler ratings. Uncertain assessment or unobserved skill is not an automatic failure rating.
Append one review event and regenerate schedule state. Corrected assessments replay applicable scheduling history rather than creating duplicate reviews.
Pause, suspend or finish on user intent; a due item is not a new Calendar task.

Keep selection/suspension and grading-derived scheduler events versioned and separate from observed attempts. Changed eligibility/rating produces a new derived schedule/configuration, not another historical learner review.
staged: Due-session plan and proposed scheduler update
published: Actual submitted answers and resulting canonical attempts through WF05
Operational review-event receipts referencing attempt/question revisions, in the existing run namespace (proposed scheduling contract)
exports/learning/review-queue.json and due.md (derived, not evidence of learner performance)
success: Due selection is reproducible from selected cards/events/config; genuine responses update schedule once; missing learner input leaves a waiting state.
No forgetting or elapsed time is misrepresented as an observed failure.
never: Run a compulsory study session in the background
Treat assistant explanations as reviews
Create external reminders without separate permission
Activate reminders or build an independent mastery/learning authority from scheduled dates
workflows.change_rationale: Scheduling is a genuinely missing conventional service. Misconception diagnosis remains WF06 and competence remains canonical attempts.
workflows.current_vs_new_boundary: Suggestions and reminders are not a functioning spaced-review system; no active adaptive review event engine or two-way card synchronization was found.

workflows.name: Apply reviewed corrections and invalidate dependents
triggers: Revised source, rubric, policy or processing version
reads: Exact target revision and original evidence
Current assessment chain and source/graph catalog
steps: Classify the issue: original data correction, assessment revision, graph/link change, recognition correction, or newly requested behavior.
Retain original text/times and existing record identities; propose a minimal revision with reason and expected previous version.
Use the owning writer and compare-and-publish policy. Assessment revisions replace interpretations for the same attempt; a new actual response is a different attempt.
Fence superseded in-flight publication and invalidate affected projections/caches/contexts only. Changes in graph wording do not automatically regrade old attempts.
Regenerate relevant views and replay affected review state. Preserve disputed states and notify dependent work of stale references.
Return a revision-linked receipt, not a silent overwrite.

Preserve the same skills and nonbranching chronological assessment_revision chain required by the actual validator. New assessed skills need an appropriate reviewed family/attempt path, not a silently widened correction.
staged: Correction/reassessment candidate and dependency impact list
published: Existing assessment_revision record where applicable
New concept/alignment/card/source versions via owning writer
Derived gap-view rebuild from the effective assessment revision (no separate canonical retraction ledger)
Invalidation and supersession receipts
success: The authorized correction is traceable to its predecessor, preserves originals and invalidates all declared dependents without expanding scope.
A conflicting branch is exposed rather than silently chosen by timestamp.
never: Edit old learner words to agree with a grade
Delete inconvenient evidence
Turn an inferred graph change into a new successful attempt
workflows.change_rationale: Different errors require different owners. A changed graph label or tool version must not silently rewrite learner history.
workflows.current_vs_new_boundary: assessment_revision and controlled tracking recovery are implemented contracts; P05 had no actual production assessment revisions and no universal dependency invalidation graph.

workflows.name: Project memory, gaps and cross-device study state
reads: Validated current catalogs/source identities and effective assessment_revision chains
Immutable full-input snapshots, separately captured tutor messages and verified receipts
Operational review events, session resume state and last verified export manifest
Approved shared-learning links and original attempt references
steps: Validate required original records and effective corrections; distinguish stale derived text from lost attempts.

Derive gap summaries from assessment analysis/missing_or_incorrect/error_types and supplied conditions. not_observed carries no diagnosis; the latest corrected assessment can retract an earlier finding.
Build concept trees from existing IDs/relation semantics with freshness/provenance. The same concept can appear in multiple displayed branches without multiple definitions or performances.
Summarize relevant conversation/resume state from immutable visible turns; do not fabricate missing historical audio or answers, nor treat the summary as independent competence.
Publish complete versioned derived output and manifest after local readback. Client checks matching bytes before rendering; local output is not proof of remote delivery.
Limit shared-learning publication to the existing owner/approved scope. Reference original evidence once and retain unmeasured independence, retention and transfer.
staged: Rebuilt gap/review/context/UX projections and hash manifest
published: Existing learning-state.md and course/shared views only through respective owners
exports/learning/concept-tree.json
exports/learning/learning-gaps.json and learning-gaps.md
exports/learning/review-queue.json when the new scheduler is approved
Operational session summary referencing immutable turns; exported UI resume pointer
Complete derived-output manifests and per-workflow task.md dashboards
success: Structured factual projections reproduce from effective canonical records and declared versions. Optional model-written prose is revision-linked, replaceable generated output; byte-identical regeneration and new learner facts are not claimed.
Remote readers validate complete manifests or keep the last verified view with an explicit stale/pending badge.
never: Treat a generated summary as new primary evidence
Call zero recorded attempts zero knowledge
Claim remote visibility from a local filesystem write
workflows.change_rationale: Rebuilding trusted views is safer than asking an LLM to overwrite one cumulative memory file. Current facts must come from original effective evidence.
workflows.current_vs_new_boundary: Learning/shared renderers and some study exports exist, with reported stale views. No universal concept-tree/gap/review/resume view producer exists.

workflows.name: Supervise health, recovery and controlled maintenance
reads: Local journal, leases, published manifests and writer receipts
Approved backup, retry and retention policy
steps: Detect unavailable runtime, expired auth/quota, stalled leases and unsynced/outdated manifests without using LLM polling.
Recover input jobs from immutable requests; reconcile provider run IDs and canonical receipts before retrying any ambiguous execution.
Resume only safe checkpointed work with a fresh fencing generation. Keep late outputs quarantined; never restore an older state over a newer valid record.
Escalate nonretryable failures and apply bounded backoff for transient ones. Isolate blocked jobs so other approved work continues.
Create consistent backups through the supported store/record contracts and exercise restores on disposable copies; retention/deletion requires its own reviewed policy.
Run configured adapter/quality regressions only on relevant changes. Propose new model/tool/prompt versions with evaluation; never self-promote them.

On update/authentication/Drive reconnect, suspend affected dispatch and reconcile the exact runtime/run outcome before rerouting. Windows error 10050 is not permission to alter a daemon, socket or firewall.
Retention/cleanup classifies full-turn snapshots referenced by canonical attempts as durable evidence even though stored below operational runs; do not sweep them as cache.
staged: Recovery decision, before/after checks and repair proposal when needed
published: Local health/journal/backup evidence
exports/learning-app/health.json (minimal nonsensitive status)
One actionable blocked/stale report or verified recovery receipt
success: Every interrupted item is reconciled or explicitly blocked; no false success, duplicate learner event, unsafe retry or silent model switch.
No workload at idle consumes model calls, and alerts do not reveal sensitive content.
never: Delete another process lock blindly
Copy a live SQLite database alone as a consistent backup
Auto-install new tools or enable new paid inference
Erase learning history as cleanup
workflows.change_rationale: Always-on hardware does not make authentication, synchronization or native execution outcomes infallible. Recovery must preserve exact prior effects.
workflows.current_vs_new_boundary: Some guarded publisher recovery and historical fixtures exist; no current companion or verified lock-screen/reboot/native-update/Drive-reconnect lifecycle was established.

evidence: P06: partial managing-agent capability report, not independently exercised
